description_short.value: Accra-based security printer and business forms manufacturer, producing cheques, labels and commercial stationery.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Camelot Ghana PLC 2023 Annual Report (GSE PR 153/2024: report of the directors, nature of business; chairman's statement)

description_full.value: Camelot Ghana PLC prints security documents and makes business forms, and also offers design work and commercial stationery printing. Its main lines are cheques, label printing on flexographic presses (a recent investment that drove most of its revenue growth in 2023), and its traditional business forms and stationery work. It was incorporated in Ghana on 8 February 1977 and listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange on 17 September 1999. A Nigerian subsidiary, Camelot Security Solutions, had not operated for a long time, and the board agreed to wind it up. At the end of 2023 West African Data Services Bureau Ltd held 46.66% of the shares and Strategic Initiatives Ltd 19.03%. The company is based on Osu-La Road, Accra.
